title: Ridgeline Pro Credit and ProBuild Rewards Goodwill Days on Ridgeline Tool Rental Downtime
content:
Renters who hold both a Ridgeline Pro Credit account and a senior Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership receive goodwill days on a Ridgeline Tool Rental downtime credit.

**Rule.** Account goodwill adds days to the lost days: a renter whose Ridgeline Pro Credit account is active and who also holds an active ProBuild membership at the ProBuild Gold, ProBuild Platinum or ProBuild Platinum Elite tier receives 1 extra day; a renter who has one of those two but not both receives half a day (0.5); a renter who has neither receives none.

The extra days are added to the lost days before the lost days are multiplied by the net daily rental cost.

## Records read

- The status on the renter's Ridgeline Pro Credit account record.
- The status and tier on the renter's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership record.

## Goodwill table

| Ridgeline Pro Credit account active | Active ProBuild membership at Gold, Platinum or Platinum Elite | Extra days |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 1 |
| yes | no | 0.5 |
| no | yes | 0.5 |
| no | no | 0 |

An active membership at ProBuild Member, Bronze or Silver, or a membership that is suspended, closed or pending verification at any tier, does not count as the second of the two.

## Hypothetical illustration

Lost days 3 and a net daily rental cost of 120.00. A renter with an active Pro Credit account and an active ProBuild Platinum membership receives 1 extra day: 4 days at 120.00, that is 480.00 before any rounding.
